Job Title
Business Intelligence (BI) Analyst

Job Description Summary
Business Intelligence (BI) Analyst

Department: Places

Operational Report: Global Operations Director, Places

Service Partner Report: Regional BI Lead

Location: Remote

Key Interfaces

Global Account Director, Account Leader, Workplace Experience Lead, Regional Workplace Managers, Workplace Managers and other team members, Sage colleagues, contracted third-party service providers and platform team members.

Role Purpose

As a key member of the Business Intelligence (BI) team supporting the Sage Workplace Management account, responsible for delivering accurate, insightful and timely reporting that enables informed operational, commercial and strategic decision making across the global portfolio.

Working in partnership with operational teams, Sage stakeholders and technical colleagues, the BI Analyst will transform complex workplace, supplier and operational data into meaningful insight, ensuring trusted reporting, effective performance management and continuous improvement across the account.

The role is responsible for developing dashboards, supporting data integration, undertaking analytical investigations and identifying trends, risks and opportunities that enhance workplace performance, colleague experience and commercial outcomes.

Responsibilities

Account management

To develop a thorough understanding of the Sage Workplace Management operating model, contractual requirements and reporting objectives, ensuring all Business Intelligence activities support successful contract delivery.

To work collaboratively with the Account Director, Account Leader, Regional Workplace Managers and Workplace Managers to understand evolving business requirements and deliver reporting solutions that support operational, commercial and strategic decision making.

To establish trusted working relationships with Sage stakeholders and Service Partner teams, acting as the primary analytical resource for Workplace Management reporting and insight.

To translate business requirements into meaningful dashboards, reports and analytical outputs that enable informed decision making across the global Workplace Management portfolio.

To support mobilisation activities, workplace transformations and operational initiatives by providing data analysis, reporting and performance insight.

To proactively identify opportunities to improve reporting capability, automate reporting and enhance the overall Business Intelligence service delivered to the account, acting as the Workplace Management representative for Business Intelligence platform enhancements and ensuring operational requirements are reflected in future reporting capability.

People

To work collaboratively with Business Intelligence colleagues, operational teams and platform specialists to promote a consistent, "One Team" approach to reporting and analytics across the account.

To provide guidance and training to Workplace Management teams in the effective use of dashboards, reporting tools and Business Intelligence platforms.

To support the development of analytical capability across the account by promoting data literacy and encouraging effective use of reporting and performance information.

To maintain effective relationships with technical teams, ensuring reporting solutions continue to evolve in line with business requirements and emerging best practice.

Performance

To design, develop and maintain interactive dashboards and reports using approved Business Intelligence platforms, ensuring information is accurate, timely and aligned with agreed reporting standards.

To prepare, validate, cleanse and transform operational data from multiple systems, maintaining high standards of data integrity and consistency.

To support the integration of new data sources into the reporting environment, working with technical teams to improve the availability, reliability and quality of operational information.

To analyse workplace, operational, supplier and financial performance data, identifying trends, risks and opportunities to improve service delivery, workplace experience and commercial performance.

To respond promptly to ad hoc analytical requests from the Client and Workplace Management leadership team.

To support the preparation of Quarterly Business Reviews, executive reporting and contractual governance reporting through the provision of accurate analysis and meaningful business insight.

To undertake benchmarking and comparative analysis to identify opportunities for continuous improvement across Workplace Management services.

To undertake user acceptance testing of new reporting functionality and dashboard releases, ensuring solutions meet agreed business requirements prior to deployment.

To work collaboratively with Business Intelligence platform teams to evaluate and support implementation of enhancements that improve reporting capability and support the evolving needs of the Sage Workplace Management account.

To maintain reporting documentation, business rules, data definitions, user guidance and analytical methodologies to ensure reporting consistency and knowledge sharing across the account.

Commercial

To identify opportunities where Business Intelligence and improved reporting can contribute to operational efficiency, service improvement and commercial value across the Workplace Management contract.

To provide analytical support for business cases, investment proposals and continuous improvement initiatives by delivering accurate operational and financial insight.

To identify trends in workplace utilisation, supplier performance and operational delivery that support informed commercial decision making and improved value for Sage.

Compliance

To ensure all reporting activities comply with agreed data governance standards, contractual obligations and information security requirements.

To work closely with the Data Governance Manager to ensure reporting is based upon trusted, validated and consistent data sources.

To maintain appropriate controls around reporting accuracy, version control and auditability, ensuring analytical outputs can be relied upon for contractual reporting and governance.

To comply with all applicable data privacy legislation, confidentiality requirements and organisational information governance policies when handling Sage data.

Direct reports

None

Personal Attributes

Knowledge

Business Intelligence principles, reporting methodologies and data visualisation best practice.

Workplace Management and Integrated Facilities Management operating models.

Operational performance measurement and Key Performance Indicators.

Data governance, data quality and information management principles.

Reporting lifecycle, ETL processes and data integration techniques.

Continuous improvement methodologies and operational performance analysis.

Managed service environments and Sage governance structures.

Skills

Excellent analytical and problem-solving capability.

Advanced dashboard development and data visualisation skills using Power BI or equivalent Business Intelligence platforms.

Strong SQL capability with an understanding of relational databases and data modelling.

Experience of APIs, data integration and modern reporting architectures.

Excellent stakeholder engagement and communication skills.

Ability to interpret complex operational data and present meaningful business insight.

Strong written communication and presentation skills.

Excellent organisational skills with the ability to prioritise competing demands.

High attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy.

Ability to simplify technical information for non-technical stakeholders.

Character and personality

Naturally curious with a passion for understanding data and identifying opportunities for improvement.

Collaborative and team oriented.

Proactive, self-motivated and solutions focused.

Calm and methodical under pressure.

Committed to continuous improvement and innovation.

Professional, credible and trusted by stakeholders.

Adaptable and comfortable working within a changing global environment.

Takes ownership and demonstrates accountability for outcomes.

Experience

Demonstrable experience delivering Business Intelligence, reporting or analytics within a complex operational environment.

Experience developing dashboards and reporting solutions using Power BI or comparable Business Intelligence platforms.

Experience translating business requirements into practical analytical solutions.

Experience working with multiple operational data sources and integrating information from disparate systems.

Experience supporting operational performance reporting, executive reporting and business governance.

Experience working within outsourced services, Workplace Management, Facilities Management or other managed service environments would be advantageous.

Education

Bachelor’s degree in business, Data Analytics, Information Systems, Technology, Computer Science or a related discipline.

Knowledge of SQL required.

Microsoft Power BI certification or equivalent desirable.

Experience with Python, Databricks, APIs or modern cloud-based analytics platforms desirable.

jobs.description:
Job Title
Senior Financial Analyst

Job Description Summary
THE OPPORTUNITY
Cushman & Wakefield is seeking a high-performing Senior Financial Analyst to join a leading Capital Markets brokerage team in Greater Los Angeles. The team specializes in complex, high-profile transactions including value-add, redevelopment, and ground-up development opportunities across office, industrial, multifamily, hospitality, and alternative assets.

This role sits at the center of deal execution—partnering directly with senior brokers and clients to drive underwriting, valuation strategy, and transaction marketing. The position offers significant exposure to institutional-quality assignments and a path for advancement within a top-tier brokerage platform. Job Description
POSITION OVERVIEW
The Senior Financial Analyst will play a critical role in underwriting and executing investment sales assignments. This individual will lead financial modeling, valuation analysis, and the development of client deliverables including Broker Opinions of Value (BOVs) and Offering Memorandums (OMs).
The role requires a strong understanding of real estate fundamentals, capital markets dynamics, and investor underwriting criteria. Candidates must be comfortable operating in a fast-paced, client-facing environment with direct exposure to ownership groups, investors, and internal deal teams.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
Financial Analysis & Underwriting
- Lead detailed financial modeling and valuation analysis using ARGUS Enterprise and Excel for a variety of asset types
- Build and audit complex discounted cash flow (DCF) models, including development and redevelopment scenarios
- Analyze rent rolls, operating statements, lease abstracts, and market assumptions to inform underwriting
- Translate underwriting into actionable pricing guidance and investment narratives

Siamo alla ricerca di una figura di livello intermedio da inserire nel perimetro di Asset Services, con l’obiettivo di contribuire alla creazione, strutturazione e progressiva crescita del Team Procurement italiano. La risorsa supporterà il Responsabile del Team nell’impostazione di processi di acquisto ordinati, tracciabili e misurabili, contribuendo alla gestione di fornitori, richieste di offerta, gare, valutazioni periodiche, scorecard e strumenti operativi di monitoraggio. Il ruolo avrà un focus sia operativo sia progettuale: da un lato presidierà le attività quotidiane di acquisto, raccolta offerte, comparazione, documentazione e follow-up; dall’altro contribuirà all’implementazione e all’utilizzo di strumenti o software dedicati alla gestione dei fornitori, delle gare, delle evidenze documentali, delle valutazioni periodiche e dei principali indicatori di performance. La risorsa opererà in stretto raccordo con i Team Aziendali coinvolti nell’attività, assicurando coerenza tra processo di acquisto, gestione amministrativa, PO, fatture fornitori, categorie di spesa e regole operative gestite tramite Yardi.
Principali responsabilità

- Contribuire alla creazione e allo sviluppo del team Procurement italiano, supportando la definizione di processi, ruoli, responsabilità, strumenti di lavoro, flussi approvativi e modalità di collaborazione con le funzioni aziendali.
- Gestire richieste di offerta, procedure di selezione, gare e richieste di proposta, raccogliendo le offerte dei fornitori, confrontandole sotto il profilo economico, tecnico e qualitativo;
- Supportare l’implementazione e l’utilizzo di strumenti o software dedicati alla gestione dei fornitori, delle gare, della documentazione, delle valutazioni periodiche, delle scorecard e dei principali indicatori di performance;
- Collaborare al processo di inserimento, qualifica, aggiornamento e monitoraggio dei fornitori, verificando la completezza della documentazione richiesta, il rispetto delle procedure aziendali;
- Mantenere aggiornati il Registro Fornitori e il Registro Contratti, monitorando scadenze, rinnovi, documentazione mancante, criticità operative, performance dei fornitori e azioni correttive;
- Presidiare il raccordo tra processo Procurement e gestione amministrativa in Yardi, con riferimento a PO, fatture fornitori, categorie di spesa, coerenza tra offerta, ordine, prestazione e documento contabile;
- Collaborare con i team aziendali per garantire un processo di acquisto ordinato, approvato, tracciabile e coerente con le esigenze operative del business;
- Supportare la preparazione di prospetti comparativi, reportistica operativa, KPI, scadenziari, vendor scorecard e strumenti di monitoraggio utili al Responsabile di Team e agli stakeholder interni;
- Contribuire alla standardizzazione di template, checklist, archivi documentali e modalità operative, favorendo un approccio omogeneo, controllabile e scalabile.
- Lavoro in team con il team Procurement EMEA;
- Supporto all’implementazione sistemi;

Requisiti
- Esperienza indicativa di circa 5 anni in ambito acquisti, procurement operations, vendor management, supply chain, facility management, real estate services o contesti operativi strutturati.
- Conoscenza concreta dei processi di acquisto.
- Capacità di contribuire alla costruzione di una funzione Procurement in fase di sviluppo, con approccio pratico, ordinato e orientato alla standardizzazione dei processi.
- Familiarità con strumenti gestionali, sistemi di procurement, repository documentali, dashboard operative o software per la gestione di fornitori, gare e valutazioni periodiche.
- Gradita conoscenza di Yardi per gestione PO, fatture fornitori, workflow approvativi, codifiche contabili e categorie di spesa.
- Ottima padronanza di Excel e del pacchetto Microsoft Office, con capacità di organizzare dati, registri, scadenziari, report e analisi operative.
- Buona capacità analitica, attenzione al dettaglio e predisposizione alla lettura di dati di spesa, registri fornitori, contratti, PO, fatture e report.
- Buona conoscenza della lingua inglese.
- Approccio pragmatico, collaborativo e orientato al servizio, con capacità di lavorare con interlocutori diversi mantenendo chiarezza, metodo e affidabilità.
- Costituisce titolo preferenziale l’esperienza in real estate, facility management, property management, servizi tecnici/soft services o contesti multi-sito. Crediamo in un approccio aperto e trasparente alla retribuzione. Per questo ruolo, la RAL è compresa tra € 38.000 e €  45,000 . Il posizionamento dipenderà dall’esperienza, dalle competenze e dall’impatto che ci aspettiamo dalla persona nel ruolo. Le persone all’inizio del loro percorso si collocano tipicamente nella parte bassa del range, mentre profili con esperienza significativa e contributo immediato possono essere posizionati nella parte alta. In casi eccezionali, possiamo riconoscere condizioni superiori al range indicato, quando il valore atteso lo giustifica. Offriamo inoltre un pacchetto complessivo che, oltre ai benefit, può includere bonus in base alle performance ed alle policy aziendali. Le nostre decisioni retributive si basano su criteri chiari, oggettivi e coerenti con il mercato e con l’equità interna.

The Senior Program Manager is responsible for leading and overseeing complex programs composed of multiple, interrelated projects to ensure delivery aligns with strategic business objectives, service commitments, and contractual obligations. Job Title
Program Management Account Liaison

Job Description Summary
The Program Management Account Liaison coordinates with the Project Management Delivery team by defining all client-specific delivery deliverables and governing the Project Management Delivery Team’s compliance with these expectations. This may include (but is not limited to), managing dashboards and client reporting, providing oversight for Landlord lease obligations, producing regular reports for internal and external use related to design, permitting, costs, schedule, procurement, and installation. The ideal candidate for this role will have at least 5 years of relevant experience and have experience serving as a Program Manager in multiple domestic markets. This role will report directly to the Senior Account Director with a dotted line accountability to the P&P Platform to enact C&W best practices for Project Management Delivery.

Job Description
Essential Job Duties :
·       Scheduling:  The Program Manager is responsible for coordinating with the dedicated project scheduler to provide the client with an ongoing schedule update on a bi-weekly basis. This schedule should align with the proposed project budget developed as noted under “Estimating”.
·       Reporting: The Program Manager is responsible for seeing that all projects utilize the same project-specific reporting as defined in a mutually developed reporting library/schedule to include cadence, format, and points of information.  The Program Manager will also develop enterprise-level reporting in concert with the project-level reporting that allows the client to gain a firm understanding of the state of each project and to share that data with senior leadership within the organization.    Financial Reporting shall be mutually developed and may include individual project and consolidated budget-to-commitments and variances, utilization of tenant improvement allowances, use of tenant improvement allowance, and cash flow projections.
·       Quality Control:  The Program Manager is responsible to identify gaps in process compliance and provide quality assurance on the delivery of project management services on projects within their programs.   When needed, the Program Manager is responsible to develop project recovery plans in collaboration with client and supporting project managers when projects within their programs incur change or risks that destabilize delivery or realization of program goals.
·       Participation:  The Program Manager may participate (as needed) in project-specific meetings hosted by the dedicated project team to remain informed on the project status and to ensure the local in-market teams are acting in compliance with the project delivery expectations noted above.  The Program Manager may also travel to the project site as needed to fulfill the requirements of this role, subject to mutual approval by the Client, the Program Manager, and the Project Director as it pertains to the best interest of the project and the client.  The Program Manager manages internal and external relationships in support of the program, including internal engagement of supporting resources.
·       Client Interaction:  The Program Manager shall be on site with the Client for regular updates according to a schedule mutually agreed upon by the Client, the Program Manager and the Project Director.  The Program Manager ensures integration between project managers and all other disciplines and stakeholders required for the successful completion of projects by coordinating communication, deliverables, and role clarity.
·       Oversight of Delivery:   The Program Manager serves as the primary point of contact for Client for the Project J and is responsible for all aspects of Project Management Delivery .   The Program Manager may recommend performance measurements for local project delivery teams to help promote and ensure compliance with the project management delivery expectations for Project J.  The scope of Project Management Delivery Services for Project J is outlined on the succeeding pages.

Job Title
Net Zero Program Manager Lead

Job Description Summary
The Net Zero Program Manager Lead combines Net Zero subject-matter leadership with day-to-day program management of the client’s decarbonization portfolio. The role shapes the roadmap, guides technical and investment priorities, and converts strategy into an executable pipeline of projects.

Job Description
Working with Account Executives, client leaders, project teams, and Sustainability specialists, this position maintains control of scope, schedule, budget, risk, dependencies, decisions, and performance. The successful candidate brings credible sustainability and building-decarbonization expertise together with the project-delivery discipline to move initiatives from concept through implementation and verified results.
Key Responsibilities
Program Delivery and Governance
• Lead day-to-day management of a portfolio of Net Zero and decarbonization projects across multiple sites and workstreams.

• Translate program objectives into defined scopes, work plans, milestones, ownership, and measurable outcomes.

• Maintain the integrated program roadmap, master schedule, governance calendar, and project pipeline.

• Establish meeting cadences, decision rights, escalation paths, and accountability across internal teams and service partners.

• Drive action-item closure, resolve cross-project dependencies, and escalate decisions that require executive direction.
Schedule Cost Risk and Change Management
• Manage schedule baselines, critical-path activities, milestones, resource constraints, and recovery plans across the portfolio.

• Maintain program-level visibility into approved budgets, commitments, actuals, forecasts, variances, and future funding needs.

• Partner with finance, procurement, and project teams to reconcile cost information and support annual and multi-year capital planning.

• Maintain risk, issue, assumption, dependency, decision, and change logs with clear owners, due dates, and mitigation actions.

• Apply change control to material changes in scope, schedule, budget, or expected outcomes and elevate variances with recommended corrective actions.

Reporting and Performance Management
• Produce standardized weekly and monthly reporting on schedule, cost, milestones, risks, decisions, and program performance.

• Develop executive dashboards and governance materials that convert detailed project information into concise, actionable insights.

• Define and maintain program KPIs for project delivery, capital deployment, energy, emissions, savings, and other agreed outcomes.

• Coordinate source-data collection and validation across project, sustainability, engineering, finance, and data teams.
Net Zero Strategy and Project Execution
• Serve as a Net Zero subject-matter lead for Account Executives and client stakeholders, advising on decarbonization pathways, building systems, electrification, energy efficiency, renewable energy, and emissions-reduction priorities.

• Own and maintain the portfolio decarbonization roadmap, including asset-level opportunities, equipment-replacement strategies, capital requirements, implementation timing, and expected energy and carbon outcomes.

• Establish evaluation and prioritization criteria that balance carbon impact, financial performance, operational needs, asset strategy, regulatory requirements, and delivery readiness.

• Guide initiatives from opportunity identification through feasibility, business case, approval, design, procurement, implementation, commissioning, measurement and verification, and closeout.

• Partner with engineering and technical specialists to validate assumptions and ensure projects meet agreed scope, schedule, budget, quality, and performance requirements.
Stakeholder and Vendor Coordination
• Coordinate client stakeholders, C&W account teams, project managers, engineering, sustainability, facilities, procurement, finance, utilities, landlords, consultants, and contractors.

• Facilitate governance meetings, working sessions, budget reviews, and executive updates; document decisions and required actions.

• Support scopes of work, RFPs, vendor evaluations, contracting, and supplier performance management as required.

• Hold internal and external teams accountable for agreed deliverables and communicate effectively with both technical and executive audiences.

Required Qualifications
• Bachelor’s degree in engineering, construction or project management, sustainability, business, real estate, or a related discipline.

• Seven or more years of progressively responsible experience spanning program or project management and Net Zero, energy, sustainability, engineering, or building decarbonization.

• Demonstrated command of scope, schedule, budget, forecasting, risk, change control, governance, and executive reporting.

• Demonstrated ability to develop decarbonization roadmaps, evaluate energy and carbon opportunities, and translate technical strategy into executable projects.

• Experience developing integrated schedules, budgets, milestone plans, dashboards, and decision-ready reporting.

• Ability to lead cross-functional teams in a matrixed organization and influence outcomes without direct authority.

• Strong analytical, communication, facilitation, and client-service skills, including experience presenting to senior leaders.

• Advanced proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint and experience with enterprise project, program, or reporting platforms.
Preferred Qualifications
• Experience delivering Net Zero, energy-efficiency, electrification, renewable-energy, building-performance, MEP, or capital-improvement programs across a large commercial real estate portfolio.

• Experience developing business cases and evaluating projects using financial, operational, energy, and carbon criteria.

• Experience in financial services, corporate real estate, or another large global enterprise environment.

• PMP or comparable program-management credential; relevant credentials such as LEED AP, CEM, or CMVP are a plus

Ability to travel 25%

jobs.description:
Job Title
Sourcing Manager

Job Description Summary
Under the direction of the Division Procurement Director, the Global Procurement Lead, is responsible for overseeing the procurement function within the portfolio of sites on a client account. This role involves managing procurement strategies, ensuring cost-effective purchasing of goods and services, and building strong relationships with suppliers.

The Global Procurement Lead will provide strategic leadership and coordination across regional procurement teams and stakeholders to support the organisation's overall objectives

Acting as the accountable global procurement owner for the client account, the role sets the global procurement strategy and strategic sourcing direction, aligns procurement objectives with the client account plan, consolidates global reporting and value delivery, and coordinates global stakeholder and supplier governance across regions.

The role develops strategic partnerships and ensures that procurement strategies are client-centric, innovative and aligned to deliver measurable client value, responsible sourcing objectives and sustainable business outcomes.

Job Description
About the Role:

Lead Global Procurement Strategy & Account Management – Own the global procurement relationship, drive procurement strategy, oversee regional alignment, track KPIs, consolidate reporting, and deliver measurable value and savings across the account.

- Manage Strategic Sourcing & Contracting Activities – Provide oversight of sourcing initiatives, RFPs, supplier negotiations, contract compliance, and contracting activities while ensuring alignment with client requirements, procurement policies, and risk management standards.
- Drive Stakeholder Engagement & Governance – Serve as the primary procurement interface for global client stakeholders, collaborate with regional procurement leads, finance, and operations teams, and lead governance discussions, escalations, and decision-making processes.
- Oversee Supplier Performance & Risk Management – Monitor supplier relationships, performance, compliance, sustainability, and supply chain risks globally, while identifying improvement opportunities and coordinating corrective actions when needed.
- Provide Functional Leadership & Continuous Improvement – Guide regional procurement teams through strategic leadership, capability development, knowledge sharing, and the adoption of analytics, AI, and digital procurement tools to enhance performance, innovation, and operational efficiency.

About You:

- Education & Qualifications – Bachelor’s degree in Business or a related field required; MBA or Master’s degree preferred.
- Extensive Procurement Experience – Over 10 years of experience in Procurement and Strategic Sourcing, supporting complex multi-country or global client accounts, preferably within facilities services or related industries.
- Strategic Sourcing & Leadership Expertise – Proven ability to develop procurement strategies, lead complex sourcing initiatives, and operate effectively within global matrix organizations.
- Stakeholder Management & Influence – Strong experience engaging senior-level clients and internal stakeholders, while influencing geographically dispersed procurement teams across complex global environments.

TARGETED COMPETENCIES

- Strategic Sourcing & Contract Management Expertise – Strong knowledge of strategic sourcing processes and procurement technologies (e-RFPs, reverse auctions, e-catalogs, contract management systems), with the ability to prepare, negotiate, and explain contracts and amendments.

Job Title
Digital Marketing Manager

Job Description Summary
Looking for a hands-on Digital Marketing talent to manage and continuously improve C&W Singapore’s digital marketing activity. Responsible for running day-to-day execution across our website, search, email and social channels, while using data and market insights to improve visibility, engagement and lead generation.
This role combines strong digital execution with a performance mindset. One will need to demonstrate strong understanding of what is working, identifying opportunities to optimise activity, and helping the Singapore BDS team use digital more effectively to support business growth.

Job Description
Key responsibilities
Website operations
- Update and publish content on the C&W Singapore website using Sitecore, including Insights pages, news and landing pages

- Load and maintain property listings on the website, ensuring details, images and availability are accurate and up to date

- Coordinate with global and regional web teams on site updates and issues

SEO, AEO and SEM
- Support search engine optimisation (SEO), including on-page content, keyword integration and content structure to improve organic visibility

- Support answer engine optimisation (AEO) to increase brand visibility, citations and referral traffic from AI search tools and LLM-powered platforms

- Support search engine marketing (SEM) execution, including ad copy, landing page content and creative assets for paid campaigns

Email marketing
- Build, test and send email campaigns and event invitations on the company's email platform

- Manage and develop the contact database, lists and segmentation, with support from the business intelligence team

- Ensure email activity complies with data protection requirements

- Report on opens, clicks and conversions

Digital and social posting
- Schedule and publish approved content on C&W Singapore's LinkedIn and other digital channels

- Maintain the content calendar and monitor comments, mentions and tags

- Manage the company's social advocacy tool, loading approved content

Demand generation & digital optimisation
- Support the development and execution of digital campaigns designed to build awareness, generate engagement and capture qualified leads for priority Singapore business lines.

Analytics and reporting
- Maintain Google Analytics (GA4) dashboards for the website and Insights pages

- Produce a monthly digital performance report covering web, search, email and social, with clear takeaways and recommendations

Marketing operations and admin
- Raise purchase orders and process vendor invoices and marketing claims in line with company finance procedures

- Track marketing spends against budget and keep budget records up to date

- Support month-end finance processes, including accruals and spend reconciliation

- Coordinate with finance and procurement teams for vendor management processes

Requirements
- 3–5 years' hands-on experience in digital marketing, ideally in B2B, professional services or real estate

- Working knowledge of SEO and SEM, including Google Ads

- Experience with Google Analytics (GA4), including building reports and interpreting data

- Experience with a content management system; Sitecore strongly preferred

- Hands-on experience with an email marketing platform (e.g. Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Marketo, HubSpot or similar)

- Experience managing LinkedIn company pages and scheduling tools

- Comfortable with admin and finance processes such as purchase orders, invoices, claims and budget tracking

- Experience with audience targeting segmentation and campaign optimisation.

- Experience supporting or running B2B demand-generation and lead-generation campaigns.

- Highly organised and detail-oriented, with a strong focus on accurate, on-time execution

- Clear written English

Nice to have
- Awareness of AEO and how brands appear in AI search tools

- Google Analytics or Google Ads certification

- Basic HTML/CSS for troubleshooting web and email content

- Familiarity with Looker Studio, Power BI or similar dashboard tools

- Experience with a social advocacy platform (e.g. Sprinklr, Hootsuite Amplify, EveryoneSocial or similar)

- Canva or basic design skills for digital assets
